interest: This document highlights Imperial Japan's cultural diplomacy and soft power outreach in Latin America immediately prior to the Pacific War, specifically targeting Brazilian university students with fully funded study trips to Japan. It also illustrates the U.S. State Department's active surveillance of Japanese educational influence and community organizations in Brazil, such as the Grêmio Cultural Brasileiro-Nipônico and the Liga Estudantina Nipo-Brasileira.
overview: This file consists of a single Department of State 'List of Papers' (Form DS-46) dated October 12, 1945, summarizing correspondence classified under decimal file 894.42732 regarding cultural relations, student exchanges, and Brazilian students attending schools in Japan. The sheet indexes two 1940 despatches sent from Brazil by William C. Burdett regarding Japanese government-sponsored travel for Brazilian students: a proposed visit by the 'Caravana de Intercambio Cultural Brazil-Japan' organized by the Grêmio Cultural Brasileiro-Nipônico, and an exchange trip of twenty recent University of São Paulo graduates under the auspices of the Liga Estudantina Nipo-Brasileira, cross-referenced to decimal files 800.20210/464 and 800.20210/488.

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers indexing 1940 despatches regarding Japanese government-funded cultural exchange trips for Brazilian university students.
subfiles.summary: A State Department Form DS-46 index sheet listing two despatches from Brazil filed under subject 894.42732. Despatch No. 2431 from Burdett, dated January 22, 1940, reports on a proposed visit to Japan by Brazilian students of the Grêmio Cultural Brasileiro-Nipônico organized as the 'Caravana de Intercambio Cultural Brazil-Japan'. Despatch No. 2660 from Burdett, dated March 2, 1940, forwards a report from Consul General Foster concerning an all-expenses-paid trip to Japan for twenty recent graduates of the University of São Paulo sponsored by the Liga Estudantina Nipo-Brasileira. Both entries note cross-references to main files 800.20210/464 and 800.20210/488.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Cultural Relations Between Japan and Brazil
